kjv: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [therefore] get wisdom
mine: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom
note: Hebrew re'shit chokmah qeneh chokmah: "the beginning of wisdom (is): acquire wisdom"; the KJV reads re'shit as "chief thing" and supplies "therefore".

kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet
mine: Make level the path of your feet
note: Hebrew palles means to make level or smooth (a path); the sense "weigh" is secondary.
